senses.definition: n.pr.loc. Joppa (Ph. יפי; Assyrian Ja(p)pu COT Gloss. Bez Tel-el-Amarna Tabl. in Brit. Mus. 146; Egyptian Ye-pu WMM 159)—seaport town of Palestine (Jerusalem), יָפוֹ Jos 19:46 Jon 1:3 2 Ch 2:15 = יָפוֹא Ezr 3:7; 𝔊 Ιοππα, mod. Jaffa.
